articles.title: GOP Campaign Cash Shifts From North Carolina to Kansas as Senate Map Changes
articles.summary: A month before the midterms, a top Senate Republican spending group is pulling back in North Carolina and making a seven-figure ad buy in Kansas, a sign of a more defensive fight for the majority.

articles.title: Congo's Ebola Outbreak Surpasses 4,000 Deaths Amid Violence and Mistrust
articles.summary: Congo says Ebola has now killed 4,018 people among about 8,300 confirmed cases. Unpaid health workers, a burned camp and limited resources are slowing the response, even as weekly cases fall.

articles.title: Intensified Russian Strikes Are "Tearing Kyiv Apart," Mayor Warns
articles.summary: Mayor Vitaliy Klitschko says Kyiv is in a "very dramatic situation" after repeated Russian strikes on a key bridge and recent hits on data centers. Russia says it is responding to Ukrainian attacks on its energy sites.
